snippet.title: [Game of Thrones: Kingsroad] Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Your house hangs by a thread. Evil lurks in the winter’s cold.
The choices you make will echo through the Seven Kingdoms.
Will you fight for honor and defend your legacy?
